new_destinations.name: Apia
new_destinations.coordinates_source: provisional: OSM Apia Clock Tower (central Apia) from candidates.json; confirm town centre place=city node with resolve-pin.py
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage Samoa/Upolu lists Apia as the capital and main city with its own See listings; Lonely Planet Samoa names Apia as the gateway city. Capital and regional hub.

spots.name: Mount Vaea
spots.bio: A 472 m summit walk above Apia to Robert Louis Stevenson's tomb, with views over the town and coast.
spots.reason: Inside Apia's greater metro area (5 km south of the centre, Vailima).

spots.name: Robert Louis Stevenson Museum
spots.bio: The Vailima house Robert Louis Stevenson built, now a museum of his collection, 5 km south of Apia.
spots.coordinates_source: osm tourism=museum Robert Louis Stevenson's Museum

spots.name: Falemata'aga - Museum of Samoa
spots.bio: Samoa's national museum in a German-era school building in central Apia, with Lapita pottery and historic items.

spots.name: Palolo Deep Marine Reserve
spots.bio: A snorkelling and turtle-watching marine reserve on Vaiala Beach, just east of Apia, with a drop-off into deep water.
spots.reason: Vaiala, east of central Apia, within the metro area.

spots.name: Papase'ea Sliding Rocks
spots.bio: A natural water slide over mossy falls into a pool, about 6 km south-west of Apia.
spots.reason: 6 km SW of Apia centre (Papase'ea), inside the metro area and span.

spots.name: Samoa Cultural Village
spots.bio: A village-style cultural show and experience in Apia covering Samoan food, crafts and traditions.
spots.pin: TODO: resolve with resolve-pin.py (no source point yet)
spots.reason: Apia (Lonely Planet places to visit); location to be confirmed by resolve-pin.py, and if it proves outside the metro area it becomes standalone.

spots.name: Immaculate Conception Cathedral, Apia
spots.bio: The large 19th-century Catholic cathedral on Apia's waterfront, damaged in 2009 and since reopened to visitors.
spots.coordinates_source: osm tourism=attraction Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception

spots.name: O Le Pupū Pu'e National Park
spots.bio: Samoa's main national park on Upolu's south coast, with lava cliffs, rainforest trails and the Mount Fito hike.
spots.wiki: O Le Pupū Pu’e National Park
spots.coordinates_source: wikivoyage listing geo (O le Pupu-Pui National Park)
spots.reason: Park legal boundary lies ~25 km from Apia, outside its bounds. Only one other kept place is inside (Togitogiga Falls; Coastal Lava Cliff Walk is review): below the four-spot bar and not a flagship, so standalone, not a destination.

spots.name: Togitogiga Falls
spots.bio: A cascade and swimming stop inside O Le Pupū Pu'e National Park, just off the cross-island road.
spots.reason: Inside the park, which is not a destination (see park reason), so standalone; a distinct swim stop, not a wrapper of the park.

spots.name: Lake Lanoto'o National Park
spots.bio: A park of volcanic crater lakes and swamp forest above Apia, reached by a 4WD track and a walk.
spots.reason: ~15 km from Apia in the central highlands, outside Apia's metro bounds; a separate park with one kept spot, so standalone.

spots.name: Papapapai-tai Falls
spots.bio: A roughly 100 m waterfall seen from a roadside viewpoint on the road to Lake Lanoto'o.
spots.reason: ~11 km from Apia on the highland road; outside the metro area, so standalone (not Apia's).

spots.name: Piula Cave Pool
spots.bio: A spring-fed freshwater pool by the sea below Piula Theological College, with caves to explore.
spots.reason: North coast near Lufilufi, ~28 km east of Apia, outside its metro bounds; not part of an eastern cluster of four spots.

spots.name: To Sua Ocean Trench
spots.bio: A deep swimming hole in the lava field with a ladder down to the sea water, near Lotofaga.
spots.reason: South-east coast, ~35 km from Apia. The south-east cluster (To Sua, Lalomanu, Namu'a; Aleipata Islands in review) has only three kept spots, so standalone; not a destination.

spots.name: Lalomanu Beach
spots.bio: A south-east coast beach with views of the Aleipata islands and a base for the coast's boat trips.
spots.reason: South-east coast ~40 km from Apia, outside its bounds; cluster below four kept spots.

spots.name: Namu'a Island
spots.bio: A small island inside the reef off Upolu's eastern tip, a boat day trip with turtle spotting.
spots.reason: Island off the east tip, outside every destination; cluster below four spots.

spots.name: Return to Paradise Beach
spots.bio: A sandy beach near Lefaga on the south-west coast, used for the 1953 film Return to Paradise.
spots.reason: Lefaga, ~25 km from Apia across the island, outside its bounds.

spots.name: Manono Island
spots.bio: A car-free island off Upolu's western tip with a footpath round the coast and a traditional village.
spots.reason: Island off the west tip, ~35 km from Apia, outside its bounds.

no_destination_notes: No destination for the south-east coast (Aleipata/Lalomanu): only 3 kept spots (Lalomanu, To Sua, Namu'a), below the four-spot bar; Aleipata Islands is review. They are standalone.
No destination for O Le Pupū Pu'e: 1 kept spot inside (Togitogiga) + 1 review, not a flagship; both stand alone.
Savai'i spots belong to samoa-savaii (not proposed here).
Standalone within ~40 km of Apia (Lanoto'o, Papapapai-tai, Piula, Return to Paradise, Manono, To Sua at ~35 km): each outside Apia's metro bounds, so not its spots.

review.name: Coastal Lava Cliff Walk
review.reason: Wikivoyage names it; a coastal walk with lava cliffs (rule 1,2)

review.name: Fuipisia Waterfalls
review.reason: Twin 54 m falls near Apia named by waterfall guides and blogs and apparently LP (poi ids appeared in search, page unreadable). Counted source UNRESOLVED; short walk, village fee.

review.name: Sopo'aga Waterfalls
review.reason: Lonely Planet lists Sopo'aga Falls (54 m into a gorge by the south coast road), tours routinely stop; viewpoint through a garden, small fee, about 15 minute visit. Counted source exists, so not OSM-only. Against: roadside, short.

review.name: Aleipata Islands
review.reason: Lonely Planet names Aleipata beaches and reefs; islands reached by boat

review.name: Apolima
review.reason: Island between islands, boat access, known but no counted source found in the pages opened

review.name: Fagaloa Bay – Uafato Tiavea Conservation Zone
review.reason: Lonely Planet lists Uafato Conservation Area: 14 sq km rainforest to ocean, carvers demonstrate, rough road round Fagaloa Bay; village bird-watching trail opened. Samoa's UNESCO tentative list. Against: remote, rough road, one counted source; name it Uafato Conservation Area.

review.name: Mulinu'u Peninsula
review.reason: Wikivoyage lists parliament, observatory, tombs; area to see

review.name: Apia Fresh Produce Market
review.reason: Wikivoyage: Marketi Fou trades Mon-Sat, kava by cup (daily hall rule 4)
